claim_boundary: These records define information required before a derivative can be built. They are not structure templates or inferred reactions.

TAMRA.blocked_reason: Generic TAMRA does not select the 5/6 isomer or attachment chemistry.

Cy5.blocked_reason: Generic Cy5 does not identify sulfonation, reactive group, linkage, or charge state.

NBD.blocked_reason: Generic NBD does not identify the leaving group or peptide nucleophile.

DOTA.blocked_reason: Generic DOTA does not identify the attachment arm, linkage, or metal complex.

Chol.blocked_reason: Cholesterol has no unique direct peptide attachment convention.

Mal.blocked_reason: Mal may mean an unreacted maleimide or a post-thiol succinimide adduct.

Dde.blocked_reason: Dde is a protecting group and must name the protected residue atom and state.
